description: Repeat a short melody by ear means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Repeat a short melody by ear in a fresh real-life scenario.
